name: @agent-core/workflow-execution
description: WORKFLOW_AGENT_EXECUTION_V2 (whole-authority successor of V1) — thin infrastructure that consumes due svc-workflow DISPATCH_INTENTs, creates exactly one execution attempt per NodeVisit, starts the canonical assignee's Agent Run with runtime-owned workflow provenance, and reconciles the attempt against the authoritative workflow state (SETTLED / ACTIVE / NEEDS_REVIEW), plus the ONE explicit authorityRef-gated controlled recovery for provably pre-admission blocked attempts (delivery_started write-ahead fence; no retry engine). Not a workflow engine and not a task platform: business consistency stays with svc-workflow's state version / idempotency / transactions.
